Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia and acidemia (low arterial pH, low O₂ saturation, low pO₂), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW and basophils, and low serum protein and glucose. These findings suggest possible acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory processes, bone marrow suppression or infiltration, and possible malnutrition. Urgent clinical evaluation is recommended to clarify underlying causes and initiate appropriate management.
